criteria.label: Problem framing
criteria.description: States who is affected, at which step, since when.
criteria.strong: Mobile users drop between plan selection and account creation since the Aug 10 plan-picker release; desktop unaffected.

criteria.label: Evidence synthesis
criteria.description: Triangulates funnel data, usability observations, and tickets; prefers behaviour over stated opinion.
criteria.weak: Relies on one source, or on what users said they'd do.
criteria.strong: Quantifies the funnel drop by step and device and ties it to specific test observations and ticket counts.

criteria.label: Root cause
criteria.description: Identifies trial discoverability on mobile and annual-price confusion; dismisses red herrings with evidence.
criteria.weak: Blames page speed or 'lower intent' without evidence.
criteria.strong: Names both the buried trial card on stacked mobile layout and the monthly-equivalent annual pricing, and explains why speed/intent don't fit.

criteria.label: Design proposal
criteria.description: Concrete, mobile-appropriate changes that address the causes.
criteria.weak: "Improve the UX" or a generic redesign.
criteria.strong: Trial first/pinned or sticky CTA on mobile; clear billed amount or monthly default; compact plan comparison.

criteria.label: Measurement
criteria.description: Defines success metric, target, and guardrails.
criteria.weak: No way to tell if it worked.
criteria.strong: Mobile plan_select→trial conversion back to pre-release levels; guardrails on annual share and billing complaints; A/B test.

criteria.label: Communication
criteria.weak: Wall of text, no clear ask.
criteria.strong: Crisp problem statement, evidence-backed findings, prioritised proposal.
